I will keep the full 1.1 mu in the usual wheat-maize rotation because that fits my land, my experience, and the irrigation I have from the well. Since my farm is small and some family labor is tied up off-farm, I will keep my management practical and stable rather than risky. For wheat, I will use improved seed, put on a moderate amount of fertilizer, irrigate at the key stages, and keep field work simple with rotary tillage because it is familiar and manageable. For maize, I will plant hybrid seed after wheat harvest because I want stronger yield on the same land, and I will use no-tillage to save time and hold moisture. I will not push inputs too hard on either crop because with only 1.1 mu I care more about getting a steady harvest than chasing the highest possible output with higher cost and labor.
